# pluto Provider

Manage Pluto policies.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "pluto" {
  host = "https://<your Pluto host>" # or PLUTO_HOST; the API key is read from PLUTO_API_KEY
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Pluto API key. Defaults to PLUTO_API_KEY.
- `host` (String) Pluto host. Defaults to PLUTO_HOST.
